reason: Research calculation components pass scoped static independent review after publication semantics and timezone fixes. Full user objective remains incomplete: real historical/environment/body-weight calibrated joint draws and validation are absent.
user_intent: Assess body-weight changes in market odds and integrate cushion, moisture and all usable history through Monte Carlo to distinguish horses.

findings.scene: All 18 saved rows: unpublished observation 14:22:36 JST, published observation 14:52:39 JST; prices labelled odds_after are as of 14:51 JST.
findings.deviation: Publication could occur after 14:51. Two snapshots demonstrate an unpublished-to-published bracket but not that the second quote incorporated publication. measured_count=18 is descriptive interval changes, not 18 measured release responses.
findings.fix: Either retain descriptive quote_at_earlier_snapshot/quote_at_later_snapshot semantics with explicit post_publication_verified=false and release_response=null, or require a quote after the published observation upper bound for guaranteed post-publication status. Do not turn these 18 rows into learned body-weight response labels. Add the within-bracket quote case to tests.

findings.scene: All-naive ISO dates compare successfully and output an interval without an absolute event time.
findings.deviation: Unlike analysis/body_weight_market.py, this script does not reject missing offsets; event-time matching could be ambiguous when input sources differ.
findings.fix: Require timezone-aware timestamps for post_time, snapshot completion, body-weight captures and quotes; record actual quote timestamp semantics.
findings.resolution: Readback confirms _time requires timezone and utcoffset; post, snapshot completion, body captures and matched quote timestamps pass through it. Four naive-input rejection test cases added; tests inspected but not executed by this reviewer.

findings.scene: rg identifies simulate_joint_trials callers only in synthetic tests. Source draws are supplied by caller, not generated from the saved 1468 histories, body weights or environment measurements.
findings.deviation: This is an empirical bootstrap integrator, not the requested complete calibrated horse/condition/market simulation.
findings.fix: Keep improvement incomplete. Data collector must recover structured historical body weights/changes and timed odds; analyzer/environment researchers must generate validated role-specific paired draws; simulator must supply calibrated whole-race draws with time cutoffs; EV must evaluate paired prices. Compare against baseline with date-separated holdouts before promotion.

evaluated_checks.evidence: Final probabilities depend only on log(base_probabilities)+environment_logits; market_log_odds_response only changes prices and EV.
Complete ordered horse_ids and unique source trial IDs enforced; one whole-race index sampled, deep-copied, source_trial_id retained; EV uses each paired probability*price.
random.Random(seed).randrange selects whole-race source draws. It controls empirical bootstrap, not upstream draw creation or actual race outcomes.
Exact event helper requires published_at; panel only snapshot changes and all18 later_quote_confirmed_after_publication=false. No release-response labels established.
Synthetic tests demonstrate contracts only. Readiness report states environment production model absent, body-weight model absent, 3-race research fit with no validation/test.
_time rejects tzinfo/utcoffset missing, used across relevant event timestamps; tests cover post/snapshot/body/quote.
docs/joint_simulation_research.md explicitly states no calibrated all-feature real-race draw, no new actual-race recommendation, and source recovery/validation still required.

data_uses.unconnected: validated market-response model and exact publication-time quotes
promoted interaction model; environment logits must come from a validated supplying role
historical pace and structured historical body weight not consumed by new MC; carried weight must not substitute horse body weight
